caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 1294 of 2010
lawyer:
Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioners 
M. A. Jabbers, Advocate, instructed by Mr. MG. Bhuiyan, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Respondents
parties:
Abu Bakkar Lashkar & others ------ Petitioners
Vs.
Rostam Ali Mondal being dead his heirs Abu Kalam & others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 10. Mr. Mohd. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the plaintiffs-petitioners, submits that the High Court Division discharged the Rule on the ground that no satisfactory explanation for the delay of fifteen years was given although the plaintiffs petitioners stated in the application under section 5 of the limitation Act that they could not file the revisional application within time because of sudden death of the learned Advocate Md. Lutfor Rahman. He further submits that the plaintiffs petitioners had no willful negligence and that they are simple, uneducated and poor rural people and that they relied on the assurance of deceased Advocate Md. Lutfor Rahman, who assured them of filing the revisional application within time and that the High Court Division without taking into consideration those facts discharged the Rule.
